department: Faculty of Medicine (HealthBRIDGE MRC Doctoral Landscape Award)

deadline.value: Applications for October 2027 entry close at 23:59 on 11 November 2026. Shortlisting is in late January, online interviews in mid-to-late February, and offers in early March 2027.
deadline.quote: Applications for HealthBRIDGE studentships for October 2027 entry are now open and will close at 23.59 UTC on 11 November 2026.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor to apply. The programme is student-led: year 1 has lab rotations, and you then design your PhD project for years 2-4.
supervisor.quote: Unlike traditional routes to a PhD, HealthBRIDGE is student-led meaning that you design your PhD project through a 1+3 training structure (year 1 lab rotations followed by a PhD in years 2-4).

funding.value: Every successful applicant gets a fully funded 4-year studentship: a UKRI stipend (GBP 23,805 in 2026-27, rising to GBP 26,500 in years 2-4) and fees covered at UKRI/home level. International places are restricted and highly competitive, and the overseas fee difference must be covered by the PhD department or by you.
funding.quote: Successful applicants will be awarded a fully funded studentship.

also.quote: International applicants are welcome to apply but places are restricted. This means that studentships are only offered to exceptional international candidates and are highly competitive.
For the PhD years, this means that the department a student registers with must make up the difference to the overseas tuition level.

entry_route.value: A first-class or good 2:1 bachelor's (or integrated master's) in a relevant, usually biological or biomedical, subject is enough; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should hold, or expect to receive, a first class or a good upper second class Honours bachelor's degree or integrated Master's degree ( or equivalent) in a relevant subject*. A pass or above at Masters level is acceptable, however a Masters degree is not required.

notes: Candidates of all nationalities may apply. Successful international candidates need separate visas for the foundation year and the PhD. The ordinary Faculty of Medicine PhD (e.g. Clinical Medicine Research in Metabolism, Digestion and Reproduction) is supervisor-first: you identify and contact a supervisor, define a project and confirm funding for the whole registration period before applying.
name: HealthBRIDGE (MRC DLA, 1+3 PhD)
